About me

A digital marketer who treats every campaign like a small experiment.

I started in digital marketing because I liked the idea that you could test an idea on Monday and see whether people actually responded to it by Friday. A year in, that's still what keeps me interested — SEO audits, ad experiments, content that gets read instead of scrolled past.

I work with small and growing businesses that need someone who can own their online presence end to end — search, social, ads and the content that ties it together — rather than handing off pieces to five different people.

Creative Thinker Data-Driven SEO Focused Result Oriented

Next up: growing into a role where I can run digital strategy for a brand from the ground up — not just individual campaigns.
